title_en: Generative AI Research Ethics Seminar (Online), 13 November 2026
summary: The department invites interested participants to an online seminar on research ethics in the use of generative AI, held at 3:00 p.m. on Friday, 13 November 2026. Those who wish to attend must pre-register through the QR code on the attached poster or the online form at https://forms.gle/ZdcV5dtHXtkp5VTq8; the Zoom link will be sent to pre-registered participants only. The notice does not state that attendance is mandatory, and it gives no registration deadline.
applies_to: The notice does not state who the seminar is for or that attendance is mandatory. Anyone who wishes to attend must pre-register.

dates.what: Seminar date and start time (online via Zoom)

conditions: The Zoom link will be sent only to those who pre-register.
A gift voucher (gifticon) will be given by lottery only to participants who both pre-registered and attended.
The notice does not state a pre-registration deadline.
steps: Pre-register using the QR code on the attached poster or the online form at https://forms.gle/ZdcV5dtHXtkp5VTq8. The poster was not read, so its content is not included here.
Wait for the Zoom link, which will be sent to pre-registered participants.
Join the seminar online through the Zoom link at 3:00 p.m. on Friday, 13 November 2026.
translation:
Generative AI Research Ethics Seminar

As the use of generative AI in research expands, we are holding a generative AI research ethics seminar, as set out below. Its aim is to prevent research misconduct that may arise from this use and to help researchers use generative AI correctly.

- Details -

❍ Date and time: Friday, 13 November 2026, 3:00 p.m.

❍ Format: Online (a Zoom link will be sent to those who pre-register)

❍ Topic: The Changing Research Environment and Research Ethics

❍ Speaker: An adjunct professor at Sogang University who serves as Secretary General of the Council of University Research Ethics (the name is in the original notice).

❍ Pre-registration: Use the QR code on the attached poster or https://forms.gle/ZdcV5dtHXtkp5VTq8

❍ Other: Gift vouchers (gifticons) will be given by lottery to those who pre-registered and attended.

Attachment (1 file): 생성형_AI_연구윤리_세미나_포스터_배포.pdf (14 MB). This poster was not read, and its content is not included in this translation.
